what_happened.line: The Select Board continued the Unitil Chase Road utility pole hearing to May 13 at 7:15 PM, after planning board permit concerns.
The board approved transfer of a liquor license to KJ Waterfront Inc for a new restaurant on Lakefront Avenue.
The town manager presented a draft land use director plan; the board will decide next week whether a bylaw is needed, with a public hearing set for April 29.
The board agreed to send a letter to the state delegation about Summer Street design money, which the governor has not released.
The board approved a Boys and Girls Club toll event and appointed a community-at-large member to the building reuse committee.

why_it_matters: If Summer Street design money is not released, the town would have to find the cost itself, which would fall on the town budget, mostly taxes.
The land use director plan would reorganize how permitting and planning staff are structured and funded, and it is tied to an article voters may be asked to act on at Town Meeting.
watch_next: April 29: public hearing on the land use administrative plan, with the board's decision on whether a bylaw is required due the week before.
May 13 at 7:15 PM: continued Unitil Chase Road pole hearing.
